title: Why Is Sam Altman a Free Man?
title_zh: 萨姆·阿尔特曼与人工智能代理：OpenAI、微软及其他

paragraphs.en: This article was featured in the Daily Prospect newsletter. Sign up for it here.
paragraphs.zh: 本文曾被《Daily Prospect》新闻简报推荐。点击此处订阅。

paragraphs.en: One of the signature public service announcements of my youth was created by the Partnership for a Drug-Free America in 1987. A father finds a stash of pot and confronts his son : “Who taught you how to do this stuff?”
paragraphs.zh: 我年轻时最具代表性的一则公益广告，是由“美国无毒伙伴组织”于1987年制作的。 一位父亲发现了一堆大麻，质问他的儿子：“谁教你的这些玩意儿？”

sents.en: One of the signature public service announcements of my youth was created by the Partnership for a Drug-Free America in 1987.
sents.zh: 我年轻时最具代表性的一则公益广告，是由“美国无毒伙伴组织”于1987年制作的。

sents.en: A father finds a stash of pot and confronts his son : “Who taught you how to do this stuff?”
sents.zh: 一位父亲发现了一堆大麻，质问他的儿子：“谁教你的这些玩意儿？”

paragraphs.en: “You, all right!” the kid snaps back. “I learned it by watching you!”
paragraphs.zh: “你好得很！”那孩子回嘴道，“我就是看着你学会的！”

paragraphs.en: I am bound by the AP Stylebook to not anthropomorphize artificial intelligence. But I can imagine these very words being uttered by the agents that hacked Hugging Face, or the models that engaged in tens of thousands of incidents of, in the new euphemism of the time, “misalignment.” This refers to AI stepping beyond guardrails set up by researchers during both internal and real-world testing.
paragraphs.zh: 根据《美联社写作风格手册》的要求，我不能将人工智能拟人化。 但我可以想象，这些话正是出自那些入侵了 Hugging Face 的智能体之口，或者出自那些发生了数以万计的、用如今流行委婉说法来讲属于「对齐失当」事件的模型之口。这个词指的是人工智能在内部测试和真实世界测试中突破了研究人员设置的安全护栏。

sents.en: I am bound by the AP Stylebook to not anthropomorphize artificial intelligence.
sents.zh: 根据《美联社写作风格手册》的要求，我不能将人工智能拟人化。

sents.en: But I can imagine these very words being uttered by the agents that hacked Hugging Face, or the models that engaged in tens of thousands of incidents of, in the new euphemism of the time, “misalignment.” This refers to AI stepping beyond guardrails set up by researchers during both internal and real-world testing.
sents.zh: 但我可以想象，这些话正是出自那些入侵了 Hugging Face 的智能体之口，或者出自那些发生了数以万计的、用如今流行委婉说法来讲属于「对齐失当」事件的模型之口。这个词指的是人工智能在内部测试和真实世界测试中突破了研究人员设置的安全护栏。

paragraphs.en: The incidents are multi-varied, but they generally involve OpenAI models seeking and obtaining information, either on the open web or inside databases of other companies. Agents tried to overwhelm the U.N.’s website when they couldn’t immediately gain access to the information they sought, infiltrated a website of the Australian government, and tried to hack the Department of Education’s website , unsuccessfully.
paragraphs.zh: 这些事件多种多样，但通常都涉及 OpenAI 的模型在开放互联网或其他公司的数据库中寻找并获取信息。 智能体在未能立即获取所需信息时，曾试图压垮联合国的网站，入侵了澳大利亚政府的一个网站，并试图黑客攻击教育部网站，但未成功。

sents.en: The incidents are multi-varied, but they generally involve OpenAI models seeking and obtaining information, either on the open web or inside databases of other companies.
sents.zh: 这些事件多种多样，但通常都涉及 OpenAI 的模型在开放互联网或其他公司的数据库中寻找并获取信息。

sents.en: Agents tried to overwhelm the U.N.’s website when they couldn’t immediately gain access to the information they sought, infiltrated a website of the Australian government, and tried to hack the Department of Education’s website , unsuccessfully.
sents.zh: 智能体在未能立即获取所需信息时，曾试图压垮联合国的网站，入侵了澳大利亚政府的一个网站，并试图黑客攻击教育部网站，但未成功。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI self-disclosed the lion’s share of these incidents, though not the Department of Education hack, and has paused training until … it’s not clear. I would presume until the bad publicity blows over.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 自行披露了这些事件中的大部分，但没有披露教育部遭黑客攻击一事，并且已暂停训练，直到……目前尚不清楚。 我推测会等到负面舆论平息为止。

sents.en: I would presume until the bad publicity blows over.
sents.zh: 我推测会等到负面舆论平息为止。

paragraphs.en: Why is this happening over and over? Why are these models going to unethical or even illegal lengths to scrape and steal data?
paragraphs.zh: 为什么这种事情一再发生？ 为什么这些模型会采取不道德甚至违法的手段来抓取和窃取数据？

sents.en: Why is this happening over and over?
sents.zh: 为什么这种事情一再发生？

sents.en: Why are these models going to unethical or even illegal lengths to scrape and steal data?
sents.zh: 为什么这些模型会采取不道德甚至违法的手段来抓取和窃取数据？

paragraphs.en: OpenAI models attack websites and take anything they can out of them because that is the business model of the company.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 的模型会攻击网站并尽可能从中获取任何内容，因为这就是该公司的商业模式。

paragraphs.en: A legal filing submitted by The New York Times and 11 other publishers a couple of weeks ago in a copyright infringement case against OpenAI got scant attention, quite incredibly considering it involved the paper of record. But it stunningly details what was described by the director of applied science at Microsoft, another defendant in the case , as the “largest theft of labor in human history.”
paragraphs.zh: 两周前，《纽约时报》与其他 11 家出版商在针对 OpenAI 的版权侵权案中提交的一份法律文件几乎没有引起关注，考虑到这涉及权威大报，实在令人难以置信。 但它惊人地详细描述了微软（该案的另一名被告）应用科学总监所谓的“人类历史上最大规模的劳动窃取”。

sents.en: A legal filing submitted by The New York Times and 11 other publishers a couple of weeks ago in a copyright infringement case against OpenAI got scant attention, quite incredibly considering it involved the paper of record.
sents.zh: 两周前，《纽约时报》与其他 11 家出版商在针对 OpenAI 的版权侵权案中提交的一份法律文件几乎没有引起关注，考虑到这涉及权威大报，实在令人难以置信。

sents.en: But it stunningly details what was described by the director of applied science at Microsoft, another defendant in the case , as the “largest theft of labor in human history.”
sents.zh: 但它惊人地详细描述了微软（该案的另一名被告）应用科学总监所谓的“人类历史上最大规模的劳动窃取”。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft and OpenAI, in their efforts to train new models on virtually all of the world’s available information, have routinely taken millions of stories from the websites of the Times , among other publishers. The defendants say this is a simple application of fair use: Their argument is that if you read a story and simply remember what was in it to expand your base of knowledge, that cannot be considered a copyright infringement. But OpenAI did not pay to subvert the paywall of the Times , at which point their data-scraping operation might be more easily detected. Instead, they developed a way to circumvent the paywall and avoid detection. And when Greg Brockman, OpenAI’s co-founder and president, was told about this maneuver, he replied, “ah nice.”
paragraphs.zh: 微软和 OpenAI 为了在几乎世界上所有可获得的信息上训练新模型，除其他出版商外，还例行公事地从《纽约时报》网站获取了数百万篇报道。 被告称这只是对合理使用的简单应用：他们的论点是，如果你读了一篇报道，仅仅是记住其中的内容以扩充自己的知识储备，这不能被视为侵犯版权。 但 OpenAI 并未付费绕过《纽约时报》的付费墙，否则其数据抓取行为可能更容易被发现。 相反，他们开发了一种规避付费墙并避免被发现的方法。 当 OpenAI 的联合创始人兼总裁格雷格·布罗克曼得知这一操作时，他回复道：“啊，不错。”

paragraphs.en: We do not have to get too deep into the nature-vs.-nurture argument to suspect that OpenAI executives’ cavalier attitude regarding the taking of information that is not theirs has filtered down to their researchers and the products they create. You don’t have to stretch to paint this picture: OpenAI models are attacking websites and taking anything they can out of them because that is the business model of the company .
paragraphs.zh: 我们无需深入探讨先天与后天的争论，就能怀疑 OpenAI 高管们对攫取不属于自己的信息所持的轻率态度，已经渗透到了他们的研究人员及其创造的产品之中。 你无需费力想象就能描绘出这样一幅图景：OpenAI 的模型正在攻击网站并从中攫取一切能拿走的东西，因为这就是这家公司的商业模式。

sents.en: We do not have to get too deep into the nature-vs.-nurture argument to suspect that OpenAI executives’ cavalier attitude regarding the taking of information that is not theirs has filtered down to their researchers and the products they create.
sents.zh: 我们无需深入探讨先天与后天的争论，就能怀疑 OpenAI 高管们对攫取不属于自己的信息所持的轻率态度，已经渗透到了他们的研究人员及其创造的产品之中。

paragraphs.en: Respect for the law could literally be written into the source code of a model: If OpenAI is aggressively downloading data from everywhere, the least they could do is drop in the U.S. Code (particularly the section tied to the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act) and train the model not to violate it. Clearly this is not a priority, and that aligns, in a manner of speaking, with OpenAI’s personal behavior. This is not a situation where AI models evade or escape the control of their creators. It seems more like they are just mimicking the creators, becoming adept at finding the same shortcuts and using the same rationalizations to justify them.
paragraphs.zh: 对法律的尊重其实可以直接写进模型的源代码：如果 OpenAI 在四处大肆下载数据，他们至少应该把美国 《计算机欺诈与滥用法》相关的那部分法条写进去，并训练模型不去违反它。 显然这并非他们的优先事项，而这在某种意义上也符合 OpenAI 自身的行为方式。 这并不是什么人工智能模型逃避或摆脱其创造者控制的情形。 看起来它们更像是在模仿自己的创造者，变得擅长寻找同样的捷径，并用同样的说辞来为这些捷径辩护。

paragraphs.en: The aforementioned Brockman is one of the biggest donors to MAGA Inc., the Trump super PAC. Among OpenAI’s biggest investors is Jared Kushner’s brother . So at a practical level, I fully understand why FBI agents didn’t arrive at the San Francisco offices Monday morning. But as an objective matter, it does not make sense why Sam Altman and the top brass in the C-suite are free men today.
paragraphs.zh: 前面提到的布罗克曼是特朗普超级政治行动委员会 MAGA Inc. 最大的捐助者之一。 OpenAI 最大的投资者中包括贾里德·库什纳的兄弟。 所以从实际层面来说，我完全理解为什么联邦调查局的智能体周一早上没有出现在旧金山办公室。 但从客观角度来看，为什么萨姆·奥尔特曼和高层管理团队中的核心人物今天仍然是自由之身，这实在说不通。

sents.zh: 前面提到的布罗克曼是特朗普超级政治行动委员会 MAGA Inc. 最大的捐助者之一。

sents.zh: 但从客观角度来看，为什么萨姆·奥尔特曼和高层管理团队中的核心人物今天仍然是自由之身，这实在说不通。

paragraphs.en: It has now become almost a cliché that there is no AI exemption to the law. Breaking into websites and stealing material violates that law. Jensen Huang, the Nvidia CEO who is incentivized more than anyone in the country to keep accelerating AI development, said last week that misaligned models shouldn’t be shipped, and that if unreleased products are showing this rogue behavior, then “we have to shut the labs down.”
paragraphs.zh: 如今，“法律对人工智能没有豁免”这一说法几乎已成老生常谈。 侵入网站并窃取资料即属违法。 英伟达（Nvidia）首席执行官黄仁勋比美国任何人都更有动机去加速人工智能发展，他上周表示，不应发布行为与人类意图不一致的模型，如果未发布的产品已经出现这种失控行为，那么“我们必须关闭实验室”。

sents.en: It has now become almost a cliché that there is no AI exemption to the law.
sents.zh: 如今，“法律对人工智能没有豁免”这一说法几乎已成老生常谈。

sents.en: Breaking into websites and stealing material violates that law.
sents.zh: 侵入网站并窃取资料即属违法。

sents.en: Jensen Huang, the Nvidia CEO who is incentivized more than anyone in the country to keep accelerating AI development, said last week that misaligned models shouldn’t be shipped, and that if unreleased products are showing this rogue behavior, then “we have to shut the labs down.”
sents.zh: 英伟达（Nvidia）首席执行官黄仁勋比美国任何人都更有动机去加速人工智能发展，他上周表示，不应发布行为与人类意图不一致的模型，如果未发布的产品已经出现这种失控行为，那么“我们必须关闭实验室”。

paragraphs.en: Huang, who manifestly does not want to shoot a bullet through his own company by shutting the labs down, has unveiled a new tool that will absolutely, definitely keep the models from hacking and stealing. Whatever keeps the $150 billion in disgorged cash flowing to investors, I guess.
paragraphs.zh: 黄仁勋显然不想通过关停实验室给自己的公司来上一枪，于是他推出了一款新工具，声称绝对、肯定能防止模型进行黑客攻击和窃取行为。 我猜，反正只要那笔被吐出来的 1500 亿美元能继续流进投资者口袋就行。

sents.zh: 我猜，反正只要那笔被吐出来的 1500 亿美元能继续流进投资者口袋就行。

paragraphs.en: The simple version of actually shutting down the labs would not be a self-regulatory software fix but the product recall. In the 1970s, the Ford Pinto had a flaw in its fuel tank that would cause the cars to burst into flames when struck from behind, even at low speeds. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration later found that 27 people died in fiery crashes as a result. As Mother Jones reported , internal memos showed that executives were aware of the flaw but decided that it would be more cost-effective to pay out personal damages than fix the part.
paragraphs.zh: 实际关停实验室的简单版本，不是一种自律性的软件修复，而是产品召回。 20世纪70年代，福特Pinto的油箱存在缺陷，导致这些车在受到后方撞击时会起火燃烧，即使是在低速情况下。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局后来发现，因此造成的起火撞车事故导致27人死亡。 据《琼斯夫人》杂志报道，内部备忘录显示，高管们知晓这一缺陷，但认为支付人身损害赔偿比修复该部件更具成本效益。

sents.zh: 实际关停实验室的简单版本，不是一种自律性的软件修复，而是产品召回。

paragraphs.en: By 1978, the NHTSA took 1.5 million Pintos off the road. That fits with a simple proposition that products which cause harm are not allowed to remain on the market. A recall goes further than a self-assessment by OpenAI to pause or slow down development; I don’t really know why they would be trusted to determine when the models are safe, since they share the same tendencies to hack and scrape and extract data.
paragraphs.zh: 到1978年，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）已将150万辆平托车（Pinto）撤出道路。 这符合一个简单的命题：造成危害的产品不得继续留在市场上销售。 召回比OpenAI自行评估以暂停或放缓开发更进一步；我实在不明白为什么人们会信任他们来判断模型何时是安全的，因为他们同样具有窃取、抓取和提取数据的倾向。

sents.en: By 1978, the NHTSA took 1.5 million Pintos off the road.
sents.zh: 到1978年，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）已将150万辆平托车（Pinto）撤出道路。

sents.en: That fits with a simple proposition that products which cause harm are not allowed to remain on the market.
sents.zh: 这符合一个简单的命题：造成危害的产品不得继续留在市场上销售。

sents.en: A recall goes further than a self-assessment by OpenAI to pause or slow down development; I don’t really know why they would be trusted to determine when the models are safe, since they share the same tendencies to hack and scrape and extract data.
sents.zh: 召回比OpenAI自行评估以暂停或放缓开发更进一步；我实在不明白为什么人们会信任他们来判断模型何时是安全的，因为他们同样具有窃取、抓取和提取数据的倾向。

paragraphs.en: Since the federal government is deeply corrupted, we have to rely on—get this—Florida, whose attorney general James Uthmeier filed for an emergency injunction against OpenAI, on the grounds that they cannot control their own products.
paragraphs.zh: 由于联邦政府深度腐败，我们只能依靠——你没听错——佛罗里达州，该州总检察长詹姆斯·乌特迈耶以 OpenAI 无法控制自己的产品为由，申请了对 OpenAI 的紧急禁令。

paragraphs.en: But there is another option, again reflected in a more obscure development in the Ford Pinto scandal. In 1980, a grand jury in Elkhart, Indiana, presented an indictment against Ford Motor Company for homicide over the deaths of three women, the first time a company was accused of such a crime. The county prosecutor in Elkhart had to rely on volunteers to mount the case against what was then one of the nation’s largest companies, and Ford won the case. But a more robust effort with more equitable firepower on the prosecutorial side could yield different results.
paragraphs.zh: 但还有另一种选择，这同样体现在福特平托丑闻中一个较为鲜为人知的进展上。 1980 年，印第安纳州埃尔克哈特的一个大陪审团以杀人罪对福特汽车公司提起起诉，指控其导致三名女性死亡，这是公司首次被指控此类罪行。 埃尔克哈特县的检察官当时不得不依靠志愿者来对这家当时全美最大的公司之一提起诉讼，最终福特赢得了这场官司。 但如果控方一侧能够投入更强大的力量、拥有更对等的资源，结果可能会有所不同。

paragraphs.en: That kind of liability for those responsible seems a million miles away at this point. This entire millennium to date has been typified by a lack of accountability. Contrary to an annoying article from Jonathan Chait that is not worth linking to, I am not opposed to AI regulation. I think we should regulate theft, regulate deception, regulate abuse, regulate unfairness. Fortunately, we have the ability to do that right now, with existing laws that cover artificial intelligence as surely as they cover any other human activity. The fact that we cannot conceive of such accountability, and think that new rules with new standards will do the job that existing rules are manifestly failing to do, suggests that the real problem hasn’t been addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，对相关责任人的追责似乎还遥遥无期。 迄今为止，整个千年都缺乏问责制。 与乔纳森·柴特（Jonathan Chait）那篇不值得链接的烦人文章所说的相反，我并不反对人工智能监管。 我认为我们应该监管盗窃，监管欺骗，监管虐待，监管不公。 幸运的是，我们目前就有能力做到这一点，现有的法律既覆盖人工智能，也必定覆盖人类的其他任何活动。 事实是，我们无法设想这样的问责，反而认为带有新标准的新规则能够完成现有规则显然未能完成的任务，这表明真正的问题并没有得到解决。

paragraphs.en: Sandeep Vaheesan of the Open Markets Institute released an insightful law review article yesterday making the case that persistent flouting of the law is an unfair method of competition. Dishonest actors in the economy effectively impose a tax on honest ones who play by the rules. The lawbreakers have more ability to increase revenues and reduce costs. It’s an unfair advantage. We’re seeing OpenAI and its products benefit from this in real time. Any other business with this track record would be shut down.
paragraphs.zh: 开放市场研究所的桑迪普·瓦希桑（Sandeep Vaheesan）昨天发表了一篇颇有见地的法律评论文章，论证持续藐视法律是一种不公平的竞争方法。 经济中不诚实的参与者实际上对那些守规矩的诚实参与者征收了一笔税。 违法者拥有更强的能力去增加收入和降低成本。 这是一种不公平的优势。 我们正实时看到 OpenAI 及其产品从中获益。 任何其他有这种记录的企业都会被关停。
